definitions.gloss: snow-covered landscape; world blanketed in snow
definitions.explanation: A poetic expression for a landscape covered entirely in white snow, evoking the image of a world turned silver.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}{起|お}きたら{一面|いちめん}の{銀世界|ぎんせかい}だった。
examples.english: When I woke up in the morning, the whole landscape was covered in snow.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}が{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}いて{街|まち}は{銀世界|ぎんせかい}に{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The snow kept falling and the town turned into a silver world.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}の{外|そと}に{広|ひろ}がる{銀世界|ぎんせかい}に{子|こ}どもたちは{大喜|おおよろこ}びした。
examples.english: The children were overjoyed at the snowy landscape spreading outside the window.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and evocative expression used to describe the beauty of a snow-covered landscape. Often appears in weather reports, travel writing, and seasonal descriptions. The word carries a positive, aesthetic connotation, focusing on the beauty rather than the inconvenience of heavy snow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一面|いちめん}の{銀世界|ぎんせかい} (a landscape entirely covered in snow)
- {銀世界|ぎんせかい}に{変|か}わる (to turn into a snowy landscape)
- {銀世界|ぎんせかい}が{広|ひろ}がる (a snowy landscape spreads out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雪景色|ゆきげしき}: snowy scenery — a more neutral, descriptive term
- {雪化粧|ゆきげしょう}: snow-covered (lit. "snow makeup") — emphasizes light dusting of snow
